blocks.text: There is no Gateway C0/C3 empirical outcome in this artifact. The PSA qualification slice stopped in C0 after 37 Chat Completions calls and `$0.093275` actual cost: that endpoint returned unversioned Flash and omitted routing metadata. A minimal OpenResponses probe returned exact 0731 and detailed dynamic provider/fallback attempts but no `usage.cost`. These controlled records establish an endpoint-level telemetry mismatch, not support for any hypothesis; C3 and the scorer did not run. Archived OpenRouter/Novita and unversioned-Flash smoke records remain historical operational evidence only.

The independent internal MemConflict mechanism gate is now complete: 72 local Codex runs across 12 reversal cases, two attempts, and the three single-agent conditions. Gate A passed and Gate B failed. Proofpress reduced stale/regression errors (12.5% to 4.2%) but did not improve trusted success over ordinary memory (83.3% versus 83.3%) and had lower task success (87.5% versus 95.8%). Because this runner lacked resolved-provider, Gateway-cost, and fallback telemetry, the result is mechanism evidence only and is not a Gateway treatment estimate. The sanitized evidence package is `../evidence/phase1-memconflict-v1/`.

Result entries must name the frozen configuration, task/source hash, fixed `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` slug, Gateway adapter version, requested/resolved model, actual provider, Gateway `usage.cost`, fallback status/metadata, token/latency values, run records, scorer output, and any applicable Proofpress capsule verification record. The first PSA C0/C3 five-checkpoint serial-SAS attempt, `gateway-0731-harvey-psa-c0-c3-qualification-v1`, failed this audit before C3/scoring because neither Chat Completions nor OpenResponses returns the complete set in one call record. Missing telemetry is a qualification failure, not a zero-cost observation or a permission to use after-the-fact aggregate reporting. ARA indexes research meaning and evidence pointers; Proofpress supplies C3 artifact-native admitted lineage and independent verification, never a benchmark agent's implicit memory or raw session transcript.
